query: db.reviews.aggregate([ { $match: { $expr: { $anyElementTrue: { $map: { input: "$helpful_votes", as: "item", in: { $gt: ["$$item", 70] } } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, title: 1, helpful_votes: 1 } }])

db.reviews.aggregate([ { $match: { $expr: { $allElementsTrue: { $map: { input: "$helpful_votes", as: "item", in: { $gt: ["$$item", 50] } } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, title: 1, helpful_votes: 1 } }])
